offering_description.value: Provides consulting, engineering, and technical services in water, environment, infrastructure, and resource management. Sells mainly to government agencies and private clients, delivered through project-based professional services.

primary_services.value: consulting; engineering design; environmental remediation; water resources management; program management

customer_segment.value: B2G: federal, state and local government agencies, military and international public bodies; B2B: utilities, commercial and industrial companies, private developers

end_markets.value: water; environment; infrastructure; energy; international development

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fees for engineering, consulting and program management work under contracts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers engineering and consulting services, sold to government and private clients

geography_served.value: global: US national operations plus offices and projects across Canada, Australia, UK, Middle East, Asia and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: water, environmental, and infrastructure consulting and engineering services sharing government clients and technical expertise

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts and bids won directly from government agencies and private clients
